purpose: Define the final DWH release decision as composition of requested scope, schema resolution, taint/classification, identity/authorization and destination policy before data crosses an external boundary.

topics.name: DWH Data Release Policy
topics.purpose: Define the final DWH release decision as composition of requested scope, schema resolution, taint/classification, identity/authorization and destination policy before data crosses an external boundary.

semantics.transform_rule: allow_transformed requires an explicit authorized projection/sanitization/declassification operation.
semantics.least_release_rule: Only data required and permitted for the explicit request is released.
semantics.evidence_rule: Decision records policy inputs, result and transformation refs where applicable.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing required policy input fails closed.
semantics.transport_rule: Release decision occurs independently from transport availability.

invariants.rule: DWH scope, release, remote access and policy decisions remain explicit, provenance-preserving and separate from transport reachability.

hard_gates.condition: missing policy input defaults to allow
transport availability treated as release permission
